label: Lifting posture
prompt: a person lifting or carrying a load with a bent back instead of bent knees

label: Deep bend or twist
prompt: a person bending deeply forward at the waist or twisting their trunk while reaching into a car door

label: Overhead reach
prompt: a person working with one or both hands raised above shoulder height

label: Awkward arm or wrist posture
prompt: a person holding an awkward or strained arm or wrist posture while fitting a part or using a tool
